evidence: Archived news leading into May 7, 2022 indicates strong downside momentum for Bitcoin following a severe macro-driven sell-off that broke below $36,000, marking one of the worst daily drops of the year. Market reporting highlights aggressive selling from short-term holders, fears of a deeper plunge toward $28,000, and analysts noting an absence of relief-rally signals. While massive OTC reserve purchases by the Luna Foundation Guard and isolated cautious bullishness provide slight support, prevailing bearish momentum and macroeconomic headwinds dominate the near-term 24-hour horizon.
limitations: Several articles covered the same Luna Foundation Guard OTC purchase and were collapsed into a single demand signal.
General adoption and long-term regulatory articles (e.g., Portugal real estate, NY PoW moratorium) were discounted as immaterial to the immediate 24-hour price action.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
